# Kavin Sermsaksakoon (Good)

> Kavin Sermsaksakoon (Thai: กวิน เสริมศักดิ์สกุล), known as Good, is the founder of Void Engineering, an AI-native company in Bangkok, Thailand. He works as a fractional CTO for Thai SME owners. He co-founded MineERP and was its COO (2022–2026). Before that he was a data engineer at Accenture (2019–2022).

## Quick facts

- Full name: Kavin Sermsaksakoon
- Thai name: กวิน เสริมศักดิ์สกุล
- Goes by: Good (also "Good Kavin", handle "goodkavin")
- Current role: Founder, Void Engineering (2026–present); fractional CTO for Thai SMEs
- Previous: Co-founder and COO, MineERP / NPR Digital Partner (2022–2026); Data Engineer, Accenture (2019–2022); Software Engineer Intern, Digital Ventures (SCB 10X) (2018)
- Based in: Bangkok, Thailand
- Languages: Thai, English
- Focus: helping Thai SMEs operate 100% digitally with practical, right-sized technology
- Email: hello@goodkav.in
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kavins/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/goodkavin
- GitHub: https://github.com/goodkavin
- Website: https://goodkav.in
